title: GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic
summary:

title: OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background
summary:
OpenAI is previewing transparent background support for GPT-Image-2 through its API. The alpha channel gets baked in during image generation, which according to OpenAI beats conventional background removal. A single parameter activates the feature.
